analysis.reasonEn: Maintaining a wait-and-see approach for 3 consecutive trading days. RSI has slightly rebounded after entering oversold territory but remains below 40. ADX is 28.8, indicating a trend, but has weakened from 33.0 five days ago. -DI is still above +DI, suggesting residual downward pressure. The price of 70,095 KRW is high relative to the 52-week low of 37,815 KRW but significantly low at the 15.0% position compared to the 52-week high of 252,500 KRW. A buy consideration is possible upon approaching the swing support at 68,045 KRW.
